description: Tier A security headers: COOP plus HSTS preload directive. Additive rule for the existing zone response-header Transform Ruleset.
notes: GitHub Pages cannot emit custom response headers. islandmountain.io is proxied by Cloudflare in front of Pages, so this rule lives on the existing zone ruleset 'Security response headers' (phase http_response_headers_transform).

ADD this rule. Do not replace the existing security-header rewrite (thin CSP, XFO, and the rest). Do not PUT the whole ruleset with only this payload; a full ruleset replace would wipe live headers including CSP and the homepage Link rule.

Zone: islandmountain.io. Ruleset id from prior Link-headers work: c0fae000097143e0ba49736efbe36c87. Confirm with GET /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_response_headers_transform/entrypoint before applying if that id is ever rotated.

Preserve observed live headers this rule does not set: Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests. Plus existing X-Frame-Options and other useful security rewrites already on the zone.

HSTS is already live as max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains. This rule SETs the same max-age and includeSubDomains and adds the preload directive on the header only. Do not submit islandmountain.io to the HSTS preload list as part of enabling this rule.
No Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is on origin responses today. same-origin-allow-popups isolates the browsing context while still allowing window.open popups (share, OAuth, chat).
Out of scope for this rule: full CSP script-src enforce, Trusted Types, Private Network Access, CSP Report-Only.

dashboard: Cloudflare Dashboard > islandmountain.io > Rules > Overview (or Transform Rules) > Modify Response Header.
Add a new rule. Do not edit the existing security-header rewrite.
When incoming requests match: Custom filter expression `true` (all responses on the zone).
Then: Set static header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy = same-origin-allow-popups.
And: Set static header Strict-Transport-Security = max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload.
Deploy. Confirm the older security-header rule and any homepage Link rule are still enabled.
api: Additive create-rule only: POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$RULESET_ID/rules with this object (minus notes/enable).
Do not PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$RULESET_ID with a rules array that contains only this rule.
After enable: curl -sI https://islandmountain.io/ must show Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups and Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload.
